cards.name: Amazons
cards.text: Four Amazon tokens may be used for conquest only, not defense. At the end of each of your Troop Redeployments, remove four tokens from the map and redeploy them at the start of your next turn.

cards.name: Dwarves
cards.text: Each Mine Region your Dwarves occupy is worth 1 bonus Victory coin at the end of your turn. This power is kept even when the Dwarves are In Decline.

cards.name: Elves
cards.text: When the enemy conquers one of your regions, keep all your Elf tokens in hand for redeployment at the end of the current player's turn, rather than discarding one back in the storage tray.

cards.name: Ghouls
cards.text: Ghoul tokens remain on the map when the race declines. Once In Decline, your Ghouls can continue to conquer new Regions in the following turns, playing exactly as if they were still Active tokens.

cards.name: Giants
cards.text: Your Giants may conquer any region adjacent to a Mountain Region they occupy at a cost of 1 less Giant token than normal. A minimum of 1 Giant token is still required.

cards.name: Halflings
cards.text: Place a Hole-in-the-Ground in each of the first 2 Regions you conquer, making them immune to opponents' conquests and to their racial and special powers.

cards.name: Humans
cards.text: Each occupied Farmland region is worth 1 bonus Victory coin at the end of your turn.

cards.name: Orcs
cards.text: Each non-empty region your Orcs conquered this turn is worth 1 bonus Victory coin at the end of your turn.

cards.name: Ratmen
cards.text: No racial benefit — their sheer number of tokens is enough!

cards.name: Skeletons
cards.text: During your Troop Redeployment, take 1 new Skeleton token from the storage tray for every 2 non-empty regions you conquered this turn.

cards.name: Sorcerers
cards.text: Once per turn per opponent, your Sorcerers can conquer a Region by substituting one of your opponent's active tokens with one of your own.

cards.name: Tritons
cards.text: Your Tritons may conquer all coastal regions (those bordering a Sea or Lake) at a cost of 1 less Triton token than normal. A minimum of 1 Triton token is still required.

cards.name: Trolls
cards.text: Place a Troll's Lair in each region you conquer. This augments the region's defense by 1 and stays in the region even after your Trolls go into Decline.

cards.name: Wizards
cards.text: Each Magic region your Wizards occupy is worth 1 bonus Victory coin at the end of your turn.

cards.name: Alchemist
cards.text: Collect 2 bonus Victory coins at the end of each turn. This stops when your race goes into Decline.

cards.name: Berserk
cards.text: You may use the Reinforcement die before each of your conquests. Roll the die first, select the region you wish to conquer, then place the required number of Race tokens (minus the die result) there.

cards.name: Bivouacking
cards.text: Deploy the 5 encampment tokens in any of your region(s) during your troop redeployment phase. Each Encampment counts as 1 Race token toward the defense of the Region.

cards.name: Commando
cards.text: You can conquer any region with 1 less race token than normal (a minimum of 1 token is still required).

cards.name: Diplomat
cards.text: At the end of your turn, you can select one opponent whose active race you did not attack this turn as your ally. You are at peace with him and he cannot attack your active race until your next turn.

cards.name: Dragon Master
cards.text: You can conquer a region using a single race token once per turn. Once conquered, place your Dragon there to make the region immune to enemy conquests as well as to their racial and special powers until your Dragon moves.

cards.name: Flying
cards.text: You can conquer any region of the map except Seas and Lakes. The regions do not need to be adjacent to ones you already occupy.

cards.name: Forest
cards.text: Collect 1 bonus Victory coin for each Forest region you occupy when your turn ends.

cards.name: Fortified
cards.text: If your race is active, you may once per turn place 1 Fortress in a region you occupy and collect 1 bonus Victory coin at turn's end.

cards.name: Heroic
cards.text: At the end of your turn, place each of your 2 Heroes in 2 different regions you occupy. These 2 regions are immune to enemy conquests as well as to their racial and special powers.

cards.name: Hill
cards.text: Collect 1 bonus Victory coin for each Hill region you occupy at turn's end.

cards.name: Merchant
cards.text: Collect 1 bonus Victory coin for any region you occupy at turn's end.

cards.name: Mounted
cards.text: You can conquer any Hill or Farmland region with 1 less Race token than normal (a minimum of 1 token is still required).

cards.name: Pillaging
cards.text: Each non-empty region you conquer this turn is worth 1 bonus Victory coin at turn's end.

cards.name: Seafaring
cards.text: As long as your Seafaring race is active, you may conquer the Seas and the Lake, considering them as 3 empty regions (only Seafaring races may occupy them).

cards.name: Spirit
cards.text: When the race tokens associated with your Spirit Special Power go into Decline, they never count toward the limit on races In Decline — you may thus end up with two different races In Decline on the map at the same time.

cards.name: Stout
cards.text: You may go In Decline at the end of a regular turn of conquests (after scoring), instead of spending an entire turn going into Decline.

cards.name: Swamp
cards.text: Collect 1 bonus Victory coin for each Swamp Region you occupy at turn's end.

cards.name: Underworld
cards.text: You may conquer any region with a Cavern with 1 less race token than normal. All Regions with a Cavern are also considered adjacent to each other for your conquest purposes.

cards.name: Wealthy
cards.text: Collect 7 bonus Victory coins (once only) at the end of your first turn.

cards.name: Cultists
cards.text: Place the Great Ancient in the first Region your Cultists conquer. This region is immune. Conquer any region adjacent to the Great Ancient (including any Region adjacent as a result of any Racial, Special Power, Popular Place or Righteous Relic you control) at 1 less Cultist token than usual. A minimum of 1 Cultist token is still required. At the start of each of your following turns, you may move your Great Ancient to the Region of your choice that your Cultists already occupy.

cards.name: Drow
cards.text: At turn's end, collect 1 bonus Victory coin for each Region they occupy that is not sharing any border with any Region containing another race (including any other, non-Drow race you may have; all of your opponents' races, even those In Decline; and Monsters).

cards.name: Flames
cards.text: When you select this race, place the Volcano on one of the Abysmal Chasm Regions marked with a Volcano symbol. Any region adjacent to the Volcano, or continuously linked to it via Regions occupied by your Flames, is attacked at the same Flames token cost as if the region was empty. Flames enter the board through the volcano; their first conquest must be in a region adjacent to it.

cards.name: Gnomes
cards.text: During their turns, other players cannot use their racial & special powers or any effect of the Places or Relics they control to conquer Regions occupied by your Gnomes. This includes indirect effects. The Gnomes' immunity to all these effects is only valid during other players' turns; during their own turn, they can still use relics, places, etc. as usual.

cards.name: Iron Dwarves
cards.text: During the Troop redeployment phase of each of your turns, take 1 additional Silver Hammer token from the tray for each Mine Region you occupy. Until the Dwarves go In Decline, you may use these Silver Hammers for conquests only, not for defense. At the end of Troop Redeployment each turn, remove all Silver Hammers from the map (leaving at least one Iron Dwarf token in each Region), taking them back in hand until your next Conquest phase.

cards.name: Kraken
cards.text: At the end of your turn, you do not have to empty any of the River regions your Kraken may be in. You can leave them in and score Victory coins for these River Regions — even once you are In Decline! Any Race hoping to pass through a River Region occupied by Kraken must conquer it first.

cards.name: Liches
cards.text: Collect 1 bonus Victory coin from any opponent each time they successfully conquer one of your In-Decline Liches' regions. An opponent with no coins remaining cannot conquer a Region occupied by your Liches.

cards.name: Lizardmen
cards.text: Your Lizardmen pass through any River Region, occupied or empty, without having to conquer it or leaving any token in it. If they conquer an occupied River Region, they still need enough tokens to conquer it normally, but once conquests are done for the turn they redeploy to land-based Regions instead of leaving tokens in the River.

cards.name: Mudmen
cards.text: During the Troop redeployment phase of your turn, take 1 new Mudman token from the tray for each Mudpool Region you occupy and deploy them in any Region(s) your Mudmen occupy.

cards.name: Mummies
cards.text: Mummies are everywhere but they tend to trip over themselves, what with all those bandages! All your conquests require 1 more Mummy token than usual (even when attacking Gnomes).

cards.name: Ogres
cards.text: Your Ogres may conquer any Region with 1 less Ogre token than usual. A minimum of 1 Ogre token is still required.

cards.name: Shadow Mimes
cards.text: When picking a Race and Special Power combo, if you select the Shadow Mimes you may immediately swap their Special Power with the Special Power of your choice, from among the 5 others visible in the list of combos. You only swap the Special Power, not any coins sitting on the combo you mimic.

cards.name: Shrooms
cards.text: Each Mushroom Forest Region your Shrooms occupy is worth 1 bonus Victory coin at turn's end.

cards.name: Spiderines
cards.text: For conquest purposes, your Spiderines consider all Regions bordering a Chasm as adjacent to the Regions they already occupy. For your first conquest, you may enter the board through any Region bordering a Chasm.

cards.name: Will-o'-Wisps
cards.text: You may use the Reinforcement die before any conquest of a Mystic Crystal Region or any Region adjacent to a Mystic Crystal Region your Will-o'-Wisps occupy. Designate the Region before you roll; regardless of the result, if you have enough tokens left to conquer it you must conquer it once the roll is made.

cards.name: Adventurous
cards.text: Collect 1 bonus Victory coin for each Region containing a Popular Place that you occupy at turn's end.

cards.name: Fisher
cards.text: Collect 1 bonus Victory coin for each complete pair of Coastal Regions that you occupy at turn's end. Coastal Regions are all those sharing a border with the River, excluding the River Regions themselves.

cards.name: Flocking
cards.text: Collect 2 bonus Victory coins if all of your Regions form a single set of adjacent Regions on the map at turn's end.

cards.name: Frightened
cards.text: Collect 1 bonus Victory coin for each Region you occupy with at least 3 Race tokens at turn's end.

cards.name: Immortal
cards.text: When the enemy conquers one of your Regions, keep all your Immortal tokens in hand for redeployment at the end of the current player's turn, rather than discarding 1 back in the storage tray.

cards.name: Magic
cards.text: The Bag-o'-Many-Things duplicates the power of 1 Righteous Relic currently in play. You decide which one each turn, using the bag to represent the Relic you choose. It cannot duplicate a Relic's power where that power already applies, and may not be stolen.

cards.name: Martyr
cards.text: Collect 1 bonus Victory coin from the bank each time one of the Regions your Martyrs occupy is conquered by an opponent.

cards.name: Mining
cards.text: Collect 1 bonus Victory coin for each Mining Region you occupy at turn's end.

cards.name: Muddy
cards.text: Collect 1 bonus Victory coin for each Muddy Region you occupy at turn's end, even when In Decline.

cards.name: Mystic
cards.text: Collect 1 bonus Victory coin for each Mystic Crystal Region you occupy at turn's end.

cards.name: Quarreling
cards.text: Collect 1 bonus Victory coin for each separate set of Regions (not sharing a common border with another group) your Quarreling tokens occupy at turn's end.

cards.name: Reborn
cards.text: Once your Reborn are In Decline, at the start of each of your turns you may empty 1 or 2 of their Regions and replace these tokens with a single new token from your Active Race in each of these Regions.

cards.name: Royal
cards.text: At the end of your turn, place your Queen in a Region your Royal tokens occupy to make it immune. If you go In Decline, your Queen stays where it was and keeps that Region immune, but can no longer be moved.

cards.name: Shield
cards.text: For each Mushroom Forest Region you occupy at the end of your Conquest phase, take 1 Mushroom Armor from the tray. Deploy these during Troop Redeployment; each Armor augments a Region's defense by 1, even when In Decline.

cards.name: Stone
cards.text: Collect 1 bonus Victory coin for each Black Mountain Region you occupy at turn's end.

cards.name: Thieving
cards.text: Collect 1 bonus Victory coin from each player with at least one active Race token bordering one of the Regions your Thieves occupy at turn's end.

cards.name: Tomb
cards.text: When going In Decline, you may keep all of your Tomb tokens on the map and redeploy them one final time before scoring for your In Decline turn. Tomb tokens in excess of those lost to conquest can keep being redeployed as if still active, until no Region is left for them.

cards.name: Vampire
cards.text: Once per turn per opponent, your Vampire tokens can conquer a Region by substituting one of your opponent's Active tokens — the only race token in its Region — with one of your own Vampire tokens.

cards.name: Vanishing
cards.text: When sending your Vanishing tokens In Decline, remove them all but collect 2 Victory coins per region they occupy, instead of 1.

cards.name: Vengeful
cards.text: Give 1 Vengeance marker to each player that attacks any of your races during his turn. During your next turn, you can attack any Region occupied by that player's tokens at a cost of 1 less token than normal. Take the markers back at the end of your turn.

cards.name: Wise
cards.text: At the end of any turn your Wise tokens are In Decline (including the turn you send them In Decline), if they still occupy at least 1 Region on the board, score 2 bonus Victory coins.

cards.name: The Flying Doormat
cards.text: Once per turn, the player whose troops control the Flying Doormat may conquer any Region, even one not adjacent to his. The Doormat moves to the new region; if the conquest fails, it remains where it was.

cards.name: Froggy's Ring
cards.text: At the end of his turn, the player whose troops control Froggy's Ring places it in a Region his troops occupy to collect 1 Victory coin from each player with at least 1 active race token bordering that Region.

cards.name: The Stinky Troll's Socks
cards.text: Once per turn, the player whose troops control the Socks may conquer 1 Region as if it was empty. The defeated player redeploys his tokens in his other Regions at turn's end.

cards.name: The Scepter of Avarice
cards.text: At the end of his turn, before scoring, the controlling player places the Scepter in a Region his troops occupy to double the Victory coins collected from that Region.

cards.name: The Shiny Orb
cards.text: Once per turn, the controlling player may use it to substitute a single active opponent token with a bonus token of his own to conquer that Region.

cards.name: The Sword of the Killer Rabbit
cards.text: Once per turn, the controlling player may conquer 1 Region using 2 less tokens than normal.

cards.name: The Altar of Souls
cards.text: At the end of each of his turns, after scoring, the occupying player may discard a single In Decline token in the Region of his choice to collect 3 bonus Victory coins at turn's end.

cards.name: The Crypt of the Tomb-raider
cards.text: At the end of his turn, the occupying player places its Ghost in any Region, except the one containing the Crypt, to make it immune.

cards.name: The Diamond Fields
cards.text: At the end of his turn, the player collects 1 bonus Victory coin for the Region the Diamond Fields are on and for any other Region his troops occupy of the same Terrain type.

cards.name: The Great Brass Pipe
cards.text: All Regions of the same Terrain type as the one in which the Great Brass Pipe is discovered are considered adjacent, for the occupying player.

cards.name: The Fountain of Youth
cards.text: At the start of his turn, the player whose troops occupy the Fountain of Youth's Region receives 1 bonus Race token (provided there is at least one left in the tray).

cards.name: The Keep on the Motherland
cards.text: Worth 1 bonus Victory coin for the occupying player at turn's end, and augments that Region's defense by 1. Both benefits persist even once the occupying troops are In Decline.

cards.name: The Mine of the Lost Dwarf
cards.text: At the end of his turn, the occupying player collects 2 bonus Victory coins, even if the occupying troops are In Decline.

cards.name: Stonehedge
cards.text: The player who discovers Stonehedge immediately draws a Special Power at random from the stack; this becomes the power associated with Stonehedge for the rest of the game (no additional Race tokens).

cards.name: The Wickedest Pentacle
cards.text: The player who discovers it immediately sends the Balrog it invokes into a neighboring Region of his choice, conquering it and making it immune to all players. In later turns the occupying player may move the Balrog again.

sets.name: Races — Power Pack 1 (Be Not Afraid... / A Spider's Web)

cards.name: Barbarians
cards.text: Your Barbarians cannot redeploy their troops at the end of each turn. If your final conquest attempt fails, keep the unused Barbarians off the board until the start of your next turn.

cards.name: Pixies
cards.text: During your Troop Redeployment, leave only a single Pixie token in each region they occupy. All your other Pixies must be kept off the board until the start of your next turn.

cards.name: Homunculi
cards.text: Each time a Homunculi Race combo is bypassed, in addition to a Victory coin, you must also add a Homunculus token from the storage tray (if any left) to the combo. These tokens are added to those normally received when the Homunculi combo is finally picked.

cards.name: Pygmies
cards.text: Each time you lose a Pygmy token, roll a reinforcement die and receive as many new Pygmies from the storage tray as you rolled pips (up to the number of Pygmies left), deploying them at the end of the current player's turn.

cards.name: Ice Witches
cards.text: Ice Witches collect 1 Winter marker for each Magic Source they control at the end of their Redeployment phase, and may place them in their own or adjacent Regions. A Winter marker permanently augments the Region's defense by 1; Regions with a Winter marker not controlled by an Ice Witch earn 1 less Victory coin than usual.

cards.name: Skags
cards.text: Randomly select and place 1 Loot marker face down in each Region you conquer. When an opponent conquers one of your regions, reveal the Loot marker: a Skag Attack marker cancels the conquest and costs the opponent a token; otherwise the opponent collects the Loot token.

cards.name: Leprechauns
cards.text: During Redeployment, place 1 Pot of Gold in any of the regions your Leprechauns occupy. Each Pot of Gold still present at the start of your next turn is worth 1 Victory coin; an opponent who conquers that region first gets the Pot of Gold instead.

cards.name: Slingmen
cards.text: Slingmen may conquer a Region that is one Region away from one they currently occupy, provided they do not control a Region adjacent to it, immediately taking 1 Victory coin from the stash. They may conquer Regions beyond the Lake, but not over the Seas.

sets.name: Special Powers — Power Pack 1 (Be Not Afraid... / A Spider's Web)

cards.name: Barricade
cards.text: Collect 3 bonus coins each time your Barricade troops occupy 4 regions or less at the end of your turn.

cards.name: Catapult
cards.text: Once per turn, place the Catapult in a region you occupy to conquer any region 1 region away (but not adjacent) at 1 less token than usual. The region with the Catapult is immune to enemy conquests and powers; the Catapult disappears when you go into Decline.

cards.name: Copycat
cards.text: At the beginning of each of your turns, place the Copycat marker on one of the six Powers from the combo list next to the board. Your active Race benefits from that Power's effect until the beginning of your next turn, or until an opponent chooses it as his combo.

cards.name: Corrupt
cards.text: Collect 1 bonus coin from any opponent each time they successfully conquer one of your active regions.

cards.name: Imperial
cards.text: For each region in excess of 3 which your Imperial troops occupy at the end of your turn, collect 1 bonus coin.

cards.name: Lava
cards.text: At the end of your turn, for each Mountain Region you occupy, you may place 1 Lava Token in an adjacent Region, taking all its tokens in hand as if conquered (without loss). The Region cannot be entered by anyone until your next turn, when the Lava Tokens are removed.

cards.name: Mercenary
cards.text: Each time you conquer a region, you may spend 1 Victory coin to reduce the number of tokens you need to conquer it by 2. A minimum of 1 token is still required.

cards.name: Soul-Touch
cards.text: When your Soul-Touch Race goes In Decline, it automatically revives your previous In-Decline Race instead of picking a new one, letting you play a full turn with it immediately.

sets.name: Races — Power Pack 2 (Royal Bonus / Grand Dames / Cursed!)

cards.name: Fauns
cards.text: During Troop Redeployment, collect 1 new Race token for each active region you conquered this turn. Your victims also receive 1 new Race token for each of their regions you conquered.

extra.Expansion: Power Pack 2 (Grand Dames of Small World)

cards.name: Nomads
cards.text: Place 1 bonus Victory coin (from the Victory stash) in each Region you abandon. You cannot conquer these Regions again this turn, but you receive the coins they hold as a bonus at turn's end.

extra.Expansion: Power Pack 2 (Grand Dames of Small World)

cards.name: Goblins
cards.text: You may conquer any In Decline Region at a cost of 1 less Goblin token than normal. A minimum of 1 token is still required.

cards.name: Priestesses
cards.text: When they go In Decline, take one Priestess token from each occupied region and stack them into a single "Ivory Tower" pile, abandoning all others. Each turn score 1 bonus Victory coin per token in the Ivory Tower instead of your usual In Decline scoring; the Ivory Tower can still be conquered like any other Region.

extra.Expansion: Power Pack 2 (Grand Dames of Small World)

cards.name: Igors
cards.text: You collect all Race tokens (Lost Tribes, Monsters, and every player's race tokens including your own) lost in conquests. At the beginning of your turn, exchange these for new Igor Race tokens at a rate equal to the number of players in the game.

cards.name: Shrubmen
cards.text: All Forest regions occupied by Shrubmen become immune to opponents' conquests, racial and special powers, even when In Decline.

cards.name: Kobolds
cards.text: You may never occupy (nor conquer) a Region with less than two Kobold tokens. When going In Decline, however, keep a single token in each Region, as normal.

cards.name: White Ladies
cards.text: Once In Decline, your White Ladies become immune to your opponents' conquests & racial & special powers!

extra.Expansion: Power Pack 2 (Grand Dames of Small World)

sets.name: Special Powers — Power Pack 2 (Royal Bonus / Grand Dames / Cursed!)

cards.name: Aquatic
cards.text: Collect 1 bonus Victory Coin for each Coastal Region you occupy. Each non-Coastal Region brings 1 less Victory Coin than usual.

cards.name: Behemoth
cards.text: Your two Behemoths are each a stack of tokens matching the number of Swamp regions you currently occupy, counting as that many Race tokens for attack and defense. A Behemoth must always be accompanied by at least one Race token.

cards.name: Cursed
cards.text: You must pay 3 Victory coins, not 1, to skip the Race that is Cursed when selecting a Race and Special Power combo. It brings no additional Special Power.

cards.name: Fireball
cards.text: During Troop Redeployment, collect 1 Fireball marker for each Magic Source you occupy. Fireballs count as 2 Race tokens but may only be used during an attack on a following turn, and are discarded once used.

cards.name: Historian
cards.text: Collect 1 bonus Victory coin for each Race In Decline at the time you select the Historians. While active, collect 1 bonus coin each time another Race goes In Decline, and 1 final bonus coin when your own Historians go In Decline.

extra.Expansion: Power Pack 2 (Grand Dames of Small World)

cards.name: Hordes of
cards.text: You may use your 2 Hordes of tokens exactly as if they were additional active Race tokens of your own Race. They disappear when you go In Decline, however.

cards.name: Peace Loving
cards.text: Collect 3 bonus Victory coins at the end of each turn during which you have attacked no active Race. You may attack In Decline Ghouls without forfeiting this bonus.

extra.Expansion: Power Pack 2 (Grand Dames of Small World)

cards.name: Ransacking
cards.text: Each time you successfully conquer a Region containing an opponent's active Race token, he must immediately pay you 1 Victory coin from his own stash (unless he has none left). You cannot ransack In Decline Ghouls.

cards.name: Were-
cards.text: Each night (even numbered game turn), you may conquer all Regions with 2 less Race tokens than normal. Your Special Power has no effect during the day (odd numbered game turn).

cards.name: Marauding
cards.text: Once your conquests are over (but before any final conquest attempt using the Reinforcement Die), take your troops back in hand, leaving at least one token per region, and go through another complete cycle of conquests.

cards.name: The Necromancer
cards.text: One player becomes the Necromancer, controlling an immune island in the central Lake and a reserve of 13+ Ghost tokens plus the Well of Souls. All race tokens lost to conquests (Lost Tribes, players' tokens, Ghosts) go into the Well of Souls instead of the storage tray; for every 4 tokens accumulated there, the Necromancer spawns a new Ghost onto the Island. On his own turn the Necromancer spends Victory coins (equal to his number of Special Powers in use plus Ghosts on the map) to buy additional Ghosts or Special Powers, then conquers Regions with his Ghosts exactly as a normal race. Ghosts are always treated as In Decline by other players. The Necromancer wins instantly if he ever has no Ghosts left in reserve or in the Well of Souls (all deployed to the map/Island); otherwise scoring proceeds normally among the other players at game end.
